core_obligations: Full faithfulness: for a morphism (a, b) in the fibre product of the F-periodic bundle colimits over Z and X', choose N so that a and b are represented by Frobenius pullbacks agreeing over E, take a finite affine cover trivialising the two bundles, use the identification colim_F H^0(X_i) = colim_F H^0(Z_i) x_{colim_F H^0(E_i)} colim_F H^0(X'_i) to lift a|_{Z_i} and b|_{X'_i} to c_i, increase N so that the c_i agree on overlaps, and glue to a morphism in the left hand category (proof lines 12319-12353).

Essential surjectivity, reduction: descend the triple (F, G, phi) along a finitely generated F_p-subalgebra A_0 of A by the limits descent lemma to assume X Noetherian, then choose a finite affine cover with F|_{Z cap X_i} free and use Zariski glueing plus full faithfulness over X_i and X_i cap X_j to reduce to F = O_Z^{oplus r} (proof lines 12364-12386).

Essential surjectivity, the case F = O_Z^{oplus r}: use phi to trivialise G|_E, use that the ideal sheaf of E is globally generated by f_1 and f_2 so that I^n/I^{n+1} tensor G|_E is globally generated on E = P^1_Z and has vanishing H^1, run the short exact sequences 0 -> I^n G/I^{n+1} G -> G/I^{n+1} G -> G/I^n G -> 0, conclude that the limit of H^0(X', G/I^n G) surjects onto A/I^{oplus r}, and apply the theorem on formal functions to produce alpha : O_{X'}^{oplus r} -> G compatible with the trivialisation over E; alpha is then an isomorphism over a neighbourhood of E, and since X' setminus E -> X setminus Z is an isomorphism the local solutions glue (proof lines 12389-12437).
proof_roadmap: Fully faithfulness by an N-increasing and gluing argument using the fibre product of the three colimits of global sections (proof lines 12319-12353).
Noetherian reduction of the triple and reduction to F free of rank r on Z (proof lines 12356-12386).
Construction of the lift through the formal functions argument on P^1_Z and the final Zariski glueing (proof lines 12389-12437).
difficulty_reason: In characteristic p, for the almost blowup square X, X', Z, E attached to two equations f_1, f_2, the lemma asserts that the functor G from the F-periodic vector bundles on X to the compatible pairs of F-periodic bundles on Z and X' is an equivalence (statement lines 12302-12316). Both directions need a genuine descent argument at the level of the colimit: full faithfulness requires choosing N large enough that maps on Z and X' agree over E, passing to a finite affine cover on which the bundles are free, replacing the colimit of global sections by the fibre product of the three colimits in the almost blowup square, and then gluing the resulting local maps after a further increase of N (proof lines 12319-12353). Essential surjectivity reduces first to the Noetherian case by descending the triple along a finitely generated subalgebra, then to X Noetherian and F = O_Z^{oplus r}, where the author uses that the ideal of E is globally generated by f_1 and f_2, that a globally generated quasi-coherent module on E = P^1_Z has vanishing H^1, and the theorem on formal functions to lift a compatible trivialisation of G along E to a map O_{X'}^{oplus r} -> G that is an isomorphism in a neighbourhood of E, and finally two Zariski glueing arguments (proof lines 12356-12437). The interaction of the Frobenius colimit with the three charts of the almost blowup square is the non-formal content, so the claim is H2.
